title: T1669 — Wi-Fi Networks
subtitle: An attacker hops from a neighboring organization's Wi-Fi into the target.
aria: Animated simulation of a Wi-Fi network attack: an attacker near the target campus phishes a neighbor organization's user, captures Wi-Fi credentials, joins the neighbor's corporate Wi-Fi, then uses stolen enterprise credentials to join the target's SSID and scan the internal network, while the SOC detects RADIUS anomalies and new-device alerts.
